title: A Local RAG Agent with LangGraph, Ollama and SurrealDB
summary: Karim Lalani builds a RAG agent that runs on local open source models, over a recipe database.
learn: Ollama runs Llama 2 locally, so you connect to a local endpoint instead of OpenAI; he argues that if it works on a smaller open source model it should carry over to proprietary ones.
SurrealDB holds two vector stores, recipes and cocktails, each loaded with 5,000 entries from Hugging Face datasets.
Without filtering or guardrails, a similarity search always returns something, even poor matches, so the graph adds a step to review retrieval quality.
The graph classifies each question as food, drink or search, retrieves from the matching store, reviews the result and falls back to a DuckDuckGo search that needs no API key.
Ollama's JSON mode plus a Pydantic schema helps keep the classification and review outputs structured, and a state object tracks the question, context and response.
